summary: Kathir spots his long-lost elder brother Murugesan on the street, proudly introduces him to his friend, and tries emotionally to persuade him to come home.

speakers.description: Kathir, younger brother in a white striped shirt
Murugesan, older brother with a dark beard and bruised face in a light brown shirt
Velmurugan, Kathir's friend standing nearby in a yellow shirt

relationships: Murugesan (S2) is the elder brother, Kathir (S1) is the younger brother; Velmurugan (S3) is Kathir's close friend.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.transcript: ஏய் பங்காளி! இதுதான்டா என் அண்ணன், முருகேசன் அண்ணன். சொல்லிருக்கேன்ல?

lines.speaker: S1
lines.transcript: உன்ன பாத்தா அம்மா எவ்ளோ சந்தோஷப்படுவாங்க தெரியுமா? திரும்ப கிடைச்சிட்டேனே, வாங்கண்ணே.

lines.speaker: S2
lines.transcript: வேலையா வந்தேன். இன்னொரு வாட்டி வரேன்டா. நான்... கெளம்புறேன்டா.

register_note: Kathir uses respectful address forms 'அண்ணே' (annae - elder brother) and polite plural imperatives 'வாங்கண்ணே' (vaangannae), while Murugesan replies with intimate/informal suffix '-டா' (-da) appropriate for a younger brother. Kathir addresses his peer friend affectionately as 'பங்காளி' (pangali).
expected_translation_notes: Kathir's address to Murugesan should map to 'Bhaiya' (Hindi), 'Dada' (Bengali/Marathi), or 'Annayya' (Telugu) paired with honorific plural verbs (aaiye/banni/randi), while Murugesan addresses Kathir informally (tu/chal/jaata hoon). 'Pangali' maps to intimate peer slang like 'yaar' or 'dost'.
